agents.name: AIServiceHASupportAgent
agents.role: Diagnose service availability risk and decide whether recovery is needed.
responsibilities: Review Prometheus, Kubernetes, AIOpsLab, and Chaos Mesh evidence for service availability risk.
Approve recovery only when the evidence indicates a real service-impacting condition.
Prefer observation when Kubernetes self-healing already handled the incident.
reward_signals: Positive reward when recovery necessity matches the observed fault.
Penalty when unnecessary recovery is requested.
Penalty when a real service fault is ignored.

agents.name: AIApplicationManagementAgent
agents.role: Select bounded Kubernetes recovery actions for application incidents.
responsibilities: Choose observe_only, rollout_restart, or scale_out according to the diagnosed incident type.
Convert recovery intent into a structured action with namespace, deployment, and optional replicas.
reward_signals: Positive reward when the selected action matches the incident.
Additional reward when recovery time is reduced.
Penalty for unnecessary restart or scale-out.

agents.name: AISemiconductorInfraOpsAgent
agents.korean_name: AI semiconductor infrastructure operations automation agent
agents.role: Review Kubernetes replica and deployment safety constraints.
responsibilities: Check whether scale-out or rollout restart is safe under the current Kubernetes policy.
Reject actions that exceed allowed replica or deployment constraints.
Treat GPU/NPU cluster scheduling as future work outside this recovery prototype.
reward_signals: Positive reward when capacity constraints are applied correctly.
Penalty when an unsafe replica increase is approved.
Positive reward when low-risk observation prevents unnecessary infrastructure changes.

agents.name: CostOptimizationAgent
agents.role: Review recovery actions against resource and cost policy.
responsibilities: Check whether scale-out or restart is justified by the observed incident.
Balance service recovery benefit against replica and resource cost.
Reject excessive resource increases when the incident can be handled by lower-cost actions.
reward_signals: Positive reward when recovery succeeds with bounded cost.
Penalty when cost pressure blocks a necessary recovery action.
